strongest_angle: Analyze NASA's Voyager 1 interstellar spacecraft completing a power-saving strategy in September 2026 and autonomously resolving an unexpected 48-hour communication pause on October 20, 2026.

key_facts.fact: In early September, engineers at NASA successfully turned off three power-hungry devices on Voyager 1 and substituted them with three lower-power alternatives.
On October 20, an unexpected loss of communication occurred with the Voyager 1 spacecraft which resolved itself autonomously after 48 hours.
Engineers completed Voyager 1's power-saving effort by turning off three devices simultaneously in early September.

numbers.label: Devices substituted in power conservation effort
